SESSION 52 — MISSIONS PAGE FULLY DECOMPILED (BindToMissions bytecode recovered)
================================================================================
(2026-07-06; offline extraction only. Game was live at menu — NOT disturbed.)

WHY THIS SESSION MATTERS
------------------------
The 2026-06-29 sessions (docs/dedicated-server-stub.md, lokiassetmanager-vtable-dump.md)
could NOT decompile the Blueprint bytecode — CUE4Parse 1.2.2 returned NULL ScriptBytecode
for this IoStore build, so they inferred the missions data path from disasm + heap RE and
concluded "needs UE network replication → build a dedicated server." That conclusion was
built on an INCOMPLETE read of the widget logic.

This session the bpdump Kismet disassembler WORKS on all mission widgets (provider.ReadScriptData
+ the S46 disassembler). Full BP logic is now recovered. Files in tools/extractor/out/:
  bpdump_BindToMissions.txt                              (43 statements — THE key one)
  bpdump_ExecuteUbergraph_WBP_UI_MissionModalCategory.txt (24 — dispatch table)
  bpdump_ExecuteUbergraph_WBP_UI_MissionContainer.txt    (137 — per-mission build+filter)
  bpdump_Create Widget for Mission.txt                   (17 — leaf widget creation)
  bpdump_OnUpdated.txt / bpdump_OnMissionsModelUpdated.txt (trampolines)

THE ACTUAL DATA PATH (authoritative, from bytecode)
---------------------------------------------------
WBP_UI_MissionModal (the modal), on open, hosts 6 HARDCODED category widgets:
  Dailies, Weekly, Seasonal, Onboarding, PCBang, ArmoryTest(hidden).

Each WBP_UI_MissionModalCategory has instance var PoolAsset = TArray<TSubclassOf<
LokiDataAsset_MissionPool>> baked into the widget (per-category pool set — see table below).
On Construct → CreateAssetsForPools (spawns one WBP_UI_MissionContainer per pool into
MissionsContainer_v2) → BindToMissions.

BindToMissions (decompiled):
  1. GetAllChildren(MissionsContainer_v2) → cast each to WBP_UI_MissionContainer_C →
     bind their OnChildrenChanged → OnChildrenCountChanged.
  2. For each class in PoolAsset[]: GetPrimaryAssetIdFromClass(pool) → Set_Add into
     instance var PoolIds.
  3. mm = GetProgressionManager().GetMissionsModel()   ← LIVE ProgressionManager at menu
     AddMulticastDelegate(mm.OnUpdated, self.OnUpdated); then call OnUpdated() once.

category.OnUpdated → ExecuteUbergraph(29) → UpdateMissionPoolTimer + UpdateMetaMission
  (just the countdown + meta-mission bar; the per-mission tiles are built by the CONTAINERS).

WBP_UI_MissionContainer.On Missions Updated / ExecuteUbergraph (the tile builder):
  - reads its MissionModel (per-container) .GetMissions() → array of mission ids
  - per mission: skip if MissionAsset.Hide; if MissionAsset.Hero is a valid PrimaryAssetId,
    show ONLY if Hero == GetPartyManager().GetPartyModel().GetSelf().HeroAssetID
    (this is the per-hunter mission filter — explains why HunterMissions are hidden unless
    the matching hunter is selected).
  - GetMissionModel(id) → if valid → Create Widget for Mission → add to ChildContainer.
  - Create Widget for Mission: casts MissionAsset.LobbyWidgetClass to
    WBP_UI_MissionProgressBase_C (or a default ChildWidgetClass) and creates it.

=> EVERYTHING hangs off ProgressionManager.GetMissionsModel() returning a UMissionsModel
   whose Missions / Pools TMaps are POPULATED. The ProgressionManager instance is LIVE at
   menu (unlike LokiPlayerState_Missions, which is CDO-only at menu). The widgets are pure
   consumers — no replication is required by the BP layer itself; it reads a client model.

UMissionsModel layout (usmap schema.txt:32047):
  Missions          Map   (keyed by PrimaryAssetId — the per-pool aggregate? or per-mission)
  Pools             Map
  CompletionCounts  Map
  OnUpdated         MulticastDelegate   ← categories subscribe here
  OnAllMissionsLoaded MulticastDelegate
  OnClaimableRewardsUpdated MulticastDelegate
  bAllMissionLoaded Bool
  MissionsActor     Object (LokiPlayerState_Missions)

MissionModel layout (usmap:31969) — the per-mission model the container reads:
  ID(Str), MissionAssetId(PAId), PoolId(PAId), XPReward(int), Objectives(Map),
  Completed(bool), bHasClaimableReward(bool), MissionAsset(obj LokiDataAsset_Mission),
  GrantedAt(DateTime), BaseMission(obj), AssetHandle(obj) + 4 delegates.

CATALOG RECOVERED THIS SESSION (tools/extractor/out/catalog/missions_catalog.json)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dumped all 346 DA_Mission* + 16 DA_MissionPool* CDOs (dump subcommand). Key facts:
  - 346 missions total: 300 HunterMissions, 17 Armory, 7 NewOnboarding, 4 Tournament,
    2 Daily, + the 16 pools.
  - 107 missions carry a localized Description; the rest are hunter-mastery tiers.
  - Mission CDOs DO NOT carry their Pool ref (Pool field empty) and pools DO NOT carry a
    mission list — so pool→mission assignment is SERVER-GRANTED at rotation time, not static.
    (Consistent with the "missions are granted" model; a menu display can synthesize a
    plausible granted set per pool.)

Per-category PoolAsset wiring (from the modal .uasset, unchanged from S46):
  Dailies   : DA_MissionPoolDailyEasy, DailyChallenge, DailyEasy_Planbee, DailyChallenge_Planbee
  Weekly    : DA_MissionPoolWeekly, WeeklyChallenge, Weekly_Planbee, WeeklyChallenge_Planbee
  Seasonal  : DA_MissionPool_Tournament
  Onboarding: DA_MissionPoolOnboardingPlanbee, DA_MissionPoolOnboarding
  PCBang    : DA_MissionPoolDailyPCB, DA_MissionPoolDailyPCB_Armory
  ArmoryTest: DA_MissionPoolArmoryOnboarding (hidden category)

THE STRATEGIC FORK (for planning)
---------------------------------
The blocker is unchanged in LOCATION (UMissionsModel maps empty) but the decompile removes
the assumption that replication is the ONLY way to fill them. Three routes:

ROUTE A — MODEL-POPULATION SHIM (recommended; mirrors catalog_store_fix + pi8):
  Find the live ProgressionManager → its MissionsModel, populate the Missions/Pools TMaps
  with synthesized MissionModel objects (using the recovered catalog), then broadcast
  MissionsModel.OnUpdated via the S50 pi8 ProcessInternal→InvokeBP game-thread primitive.
  This is the SAME shortcut that made the roster render (catalog_ready_fix forced a gate;
  here we fill a model + fire its delegate). Reuses: obj_iter.py, the mirror-poll pattern,
  InvokeBP. Risk: constructing valid UMissionModel UObjects + TMap insertion is fiddly;
  the S45 "poke built grid = dead delegate" gotcha means we must fire OnUpdated, not just
  poke — which pi8 can do.

ROUTE B — HTTP FEED PROBE (cheap first test, do BEFORE committing to A or C):
  ProgressionManager : PlatformManager, same family as the managers that ARE HTTP-fed. The
  client already calls GET /progression/players/{id} (174x) + PUT .../mission (21x). The
  2026-06-29 note says enriching the PUT *response* did NOT create UMissionModels — but that
  tested the wrong endpoint/shape (PUT is fire-and-forget; GET returns a paging list). No one
  has shaped GET /progression/players/{id} as a MissionData/MissionDataResponse feed and
  watched the MissionsModel. One single-variable backend probe (per CLAUDE.md revert rule)
  could confirm/kill the HTTP path for pennies before spending days on A or C.

ROUTE C — DEDICATED SERVER (docs/dedicated-server-stub.md; the pre-decompile plan):
  Build a UE5.4 dedicated server that replicates LokiPlayerState_Missions. Largest lift;
  only strictly necessary if BOTH A and B fail. Branch name reflects this intent, but NO
  dedicated-server code is committed yet — nothing is lost by trying A/B first.

RECOMMENDATION: B (one probe) → A (shim) if B fails. C only as last resort. This matches the
project's proven pattern (native gate/model shim + backend data) that already brought the
roster, store, cosmetics, and main-menu refresh online — all of which were once thought to
need replication/deep RE.

=================================================================================
ROUTE B RESULT — CLOSED (2026-07-06, evidence-based, no relaunch needed)
=================================================================================
Investigated B via the 13GB live capture.log + the live Loki.log (client was up at menu;
the user had opened the Missions modal at 20:00:33 today). Conclusive negatives:

1. NO mission HTTP endpoint EXISTS in the entire capture. rg over docs/capture.log (13.5GB):
   zero hits for /mission, /checkin, /check-in, /season, /quest. The ONLY progression traffic
   is  GET /progression/players/{id}  and  GET /progression/players/{id}/tracks. (The
   PUT .../mission seen in 2026-06-26 sessions is GONE from this build's traffic.)
2. The client emits ZERO mission-fetch activity at menu. Live Loki.log around the modal open
   shows: 6x "DateTime in bad format (year 0...)" (the empty pool-timers reading all-zero
   NewMissionTime/GrantedAt) immediately before WBP_UI_MissionModal opens — i.e. the category
   widgets DID run OnUpdated, but against an EMPTY MissionsModel. No checkin query, no
   OnPSMissionsUpdated, no "checked for new missions".
3. GET /progression/players/{id} is AccelByte-standard progression
   (FAccelByteModelsListUserProgressionInfoPagingSliced = stats/tracks), NOT a mission carrier.
   Its consumer is the progression-tracks system, not MissionsModel.

=> There is no HTTP hook to populate MissionsModel in this build. Re-running a live backend
   probe would only re-confirm this at the cost of disrupting the session. B is CLOSED by
   evidence, consistent with (but stronger than) the 2026-06-29 "needs replication" read.
   The reframe still holds: the BP layer reads a CLIENT-SIDE model; Route A fills it directly
   and bypasses the (nonexistent) delivery path entirely — exactly like catalog_ready_fix.

ASSET-RESOLUTION CAVEAT for Route A (from the same Loki.log): at menu load there are 8x
"RequestAsyncLoad() called with empty or only null assets!" + 1 "Invalid Primary Asset Type:
ChangeBundleStateForPrimaryAssets failed to find NameData" — the SHARED LokiAssetManager gate
(same as hero/store), NOT mission-specific. Implication: each MissionModel we synthesize needs
its MissionAsset (LokiDataAsset_Mission) to be a LOADED object so the container can read
Hide/Hero/LobbyWidgetClass. The mission DA assets ARE cooked/packaged (we dumped 346 via
CUE4Parse), so they can be loaded by direct object path even without primary-asset
registration — but this must be validated live during the A build (load one DA_Mission by
path, confirm the object resolves, before wiring 300+).

=================================================================================
ROUTE A PLAN (the path forward)
=================================================================================
Primitives all exist: tools/re/obj_iter.py + find_guobjectarray.py (GUObjectArray walk),
resolve_delegate.py (delegate broadcast targets), tools/sigbypass-mod/mainmenu_refresh_pi8.cpp
(the S50 ProcessInternal→InvokeBP game-thread BP-call primitive — reusable to broadcast
MissionsModel.OnUpdated and to call BP factory functions on the game thread).

Step A1 (read-only, non-disruptive) — LOCATE + VALIDATE TARGET:  *** DONE 2026-07-06 ***
  Ran tools/re/obj_iter.py + tools/re/missions_probe.py against the live client (PID 57832,
  module base 0x7FF682A80000 — obj_iter's hardcoded base happened to match this launch).
  VALIDATED (all read-only RPM, client not disturbed):
    - Live ProgressionManager instance (NOT the CDO): 0x26A25C07A20.
    - ProgressionManager+0x3B8 -> MissionsModel 0x26B135FEF80 (Outer == the ProgressionManager,
      so this IS the menu model the widgets read). The other live MissionsModel 0x26B09558800
      is owned by EndOfGameModel (ignore).
    - MissionsModel 0x26B135FEF80 layout: UObject hdr (Class@+0x18, Name@+0x20 FName idx
      0x00590044, Outer@+0x28). Three TMap/TSet blocks at +0x30 / +0x80 / +0xD0 (0x50 stride,
      = Missions / Pools / CompletionCounts). ALL EMPTY — null Data ptr, FScriptSet empty
      signature (0x80 hashsize + FirstFreeIndex=-1 at +0x5C/+0x60, +0xAC/+0xB0, +0xFC/+0x100).
  => Blocker CONFIRMED empirically: the menu MissionsModel exists, the BP layer subscribes to
     it, and its maps are simply empty. Populate these 3 maps + broadcast OnUpdated = the fix.
  A1 asset-load check (obj_iter, live): the 16 DA_MissionPool CDOs ARE loaded objects
  (Default__DA_MissionPool*_C present), so pool CLASSES resolve. Individual mission DAs are
  NOT loaded at menu (DA_Mission_ArmoryDaily_PlayAGame -> 0 objects) — they are async-loaded
  on demand. MissionModel has AssetHandle + OnAssetLoaded, so the native factory
  (CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress) triggers the load of MissionAssetId. Caveat: that load
  goes through the AssetManager (shared "failed to find NameData" gate); may need load-by-path
  instead of primary-asset-id. Resolve during the shim build. (NOTE: all heap addrs are
  per-launch; re-locate via obj_iter each session — this launch base=0x7FF682A80000.)

CONSUMPTION WIRING (fully mapped — CreateAssetsForPools + InitWithModel bytecode):
  Category.CreateAssetsForPools (on Construct): ClearChildren, then per pool class in
  PoolAsset[]: Create WBP_UI_MissionContainer -> set ChildWidgetClass=
  WBP_UI_MissionModal_MissionEntry_C + ObjectiveWidgetClass=WBP_UI_MissionObjectiveProgress_C
  -> mm = GetProgressionManager().GetMissionsModel() -> container.InitWithModel(mm, poolClass)
  -> AddChildToVerticalBox.
  InitWithModel(model, poolClass): sets container.MissionModel = mm (THE SHARED UMissionsModel,
  NOT a per-pool object) and container.PoolAsset = poolClass, then runs its ubergraph.
  => EVERY container points at the same MissionsModel (0x...FEF80) and reads it via native
     GetMissions() / GetMissionModel(id), filtering by its own PoolAsset. So there is exactly
     ONE object to populate.

NATIVE MISSION FUNCTIONS (usmapdump nameid on the live exe; all in NamePool block 89, one
class's method cluster) — the shim calls THESE instead of hand-rolling FScriptMap insertion:
    CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress  id=0x0059005C   (FACTORY: builds a UMissionModel)
    GetActiveMissionModel                id=0x0059007A
    GetMissionModel                      id=0x005900A1
    GetMissionModelsForAssetID           id=0x005900AA
    GetMissions                          id=0x005900B8   (reader; proven BP-callable)
    OnPSMissionsUpdated                  id=0x005900CA   (INGEST handler: replicated data ->
                                                          populate maps -> broadcast OnUpdated)
  GetMissions/GetMissionModel/GetActiveMissionModel are called as StackNodes from BP bytecode,
  so they are UFunctions (callable via the pi8 InvokeBP game-thread primitive). Factory + ingest
  need their UFunction/signature confirmed at build time (findptr the name id -> UFunction obj).

SHIM DESIGN (missions_populate, built on tools/sigbypass-mod/mainmenu_refresh_pi8.cpp):
  Phase 1 (READ-ONLY, zero write risk): hook ProcessInternal (pi8), locate the live
    ProgressionManager (obj_iter logic in C++) -> MissionsModel@+0x3B8, InvokeBP GetMissions()
    on the game thread, log the returned count. Proves the harness + confirms empty. NO writes.
  Phase 2 (POPULATE, smoke test): for 1 pool (DA_MissionPoolDailyEasy) + its ~2 dailies, call
    CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress to build UMissionModels (game does the alloc + async
    asset load), get them into MissionsModel.Missions (via the factory's own insert, or the
    ingest path), then InvokeBP the MissionsModel OnUpdated broadcast. Verify Dailies tab
    renders the tile(s) (computer-use screenshot).
  Phase 3 (SCALE): all 6 categories from missions_catalog.json; per-hunter Hero filter; make
    durable (re-broadcast on modal-open hook or shim_watch poll).
  CRASH RISK: Phase 2 is the first live-write; approach incrementally, one call at a time,
    SafeWrite hook install (pi8), and watch Loki.log. Coordinate reln with the user (their
    client is live).

PHASE 1 BUILT + INJECTED + VALIDATED (2026-07-06, live PID 57832, read-only, no crash):
  tools/sigbypass-mod/missions_populate.cpp (clang++ -> .dll, manual-mapped via inject mmap).
  Marker docs/missions-populate-marker.txt confirmed IN-PROCESS:
    - ProgressionManager 0x26A25C07A20 ; 19 MissionPool CDOs loaded.
    - MissionsModel 0x26B135FEF80 (Outer==ProgMgr). Maps: Missions=0 Pools=0 CompletionCounts=0.
    - ALL 5 mission UFunctions resolved, ALL with Outer=MissionsModel (so callable via pi8
      InvokeBP on the game thread):
        CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress @0x26A2A3448B0   <- FACTORY (Phase 2 entry point)
        GetActiveMissionModel               @0x26A2A344A90
        GetMissionModel                     @0x26A2A344D60
        GetMissions                         @0x26A2A344F40   <- reader (verify after populate)
        OnPSMissionsUpdated                 @0x26A2A345210   <- ingest handler
      (these addrs are per-launch UFunction OBJECT ptrs; the shim resolves them live by
      name+Outer each run — do NOT hardcode.)
  => Harness has everything Phase 2 needs.

FULL MissionsModel API (walked live via tools/re/ufunc_sig.py — UFunction.ChildProperties@+0x58,
FField: FFieldClass@+0x08 Next@+0x18 Name@+0x20 ElemSize@+0x34 Flags@+0x38; all 12 methods,
Outer=MissionsModel UClass @0x26A306E1F00; UClass.Children(UField*)@+0x50, UField.Next@+0x30):
    OnPSMissionsUpdated()                              (no params — native replication orchestrator)
    OnMissionAssetLoaded(Object MissionModel)
    HasClaimableMission(Struct MissionID) -> Bool
    GetMissions() -> Array                             <- container reads this (mission id list)
    GetMissionModelsForAssetID(out Struct MissionID) -> Array
    GetMissionModel(Str ID) -> Object                 <- container reads this (id -> UMissionModel)
    GetCurrentAndTotalProgress(Object MissionAsset, out int Cur, out int Total) -> Bool
    GetClaimableMissionModel(Struct MissionID) -> Object
    GetActiveMissionModel(out Struct MissionID) -> Object   <- category reads this
    CreateMissionsModel(Object PSMissions) -> Object  <- top-level build from a LokiPlayerState_Missions
    CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress(ref Array<MissionProgress>) -> Object  <- per-mission FACTORY
    CountCompleteMissionsFromPools(out Array PoolIDs, out int Completed, out int Total)
  KEY consequences:
    - Missions TMap is keyed by FString (GetMissionModel takes Str ID); value = UMissionModel*.
      Manual insert therefore needs FString GetTypeHash (case-insensitive FCrc) — fiddly.
    - No AddMission/SetMissions — insertion is internal to OnPSMissionsUpdated / CreateMissionsModel,
      both of which need a LokiPlayerState_Missions (PSMissions) source object (none at menu).
    - CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress BUILDS a UMissionModel from a MissionProgress[] but does
      NOT insert it. MissionProgress struct (usmap:32018): ID(Str) AssetId(FPrimaryAssetId)
      PoolId(FPrimaryAssetId) Complete(bool) Failed(bool) ObjectiveProgress(Array<int64>)
      MillisUntilExpiry(int64) Expiry(DateTime) GrantedAt(DateTime).
  Phase-2 approaches (ranked): (A) build a fake LokiPlayerState_Missions with Missions/
    FinalMissionProgress arrays -> CreateMissionsModel(it) -> swap result into ProgMgr+0x3B8 ->
    broadcast; (B) per mission: CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress(progArr) -> UMissionModel* ->
    manual FString-keyed TMap insert into MissionsModel.Missions -> broadcast OnUpdated.
    Both need the game-thread native-call-with-params+return primitive (pi8 InvokeBP is
    parameterless-only) — building + validating THAT (safe read call first) is the next increment.

*** PHASE 2 PRIMITIVE UNLOCKED + VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-06, clean relaunch PID 27412, NO CRASH) ***
tools/sigbypass-mod/missions_call_probe.cpp: hook ProcessInternal (get on game thread) -> call the
game's ProcessEvent(base+0x12C5A10)(MissionsModel, GetMissions_UFunc, &resultTArray). Marker
docs/missions-call-probe-marker.txt: "GetMissions -> TArray{Num=0} ... ProcessEvent CAN call native
MissionsModel methods on the game thread. Phase-2 primitive UNLOCKED." So pi8's "ProcessEvent no-ops"
finding was BP-func-specific (re-entrancy); for a NATIVE UFunction ProcessEvent dispatches straight to
the thunk and WORKS from the PI hook. => we can now call ANY MissionsModel native (factory/readers/
ingest) with params+return on the game thread. This is the core Route-A enabler.

RELAUNCH RECIPE for missions work (pi8 must be OUT — it also hooks ProcessInternal; ONE PI hook only):
  kill game; launch-redirect.ps1 -Hook "...\catalog_store_fix.dll"  (explicit -Hook => NO secondaries,
  i.e. no pi8; catalog_store_fix does NOT hook PI so roster/store still work). Then inject the missions
  shim via inject.exe mmap <PID>. (Menu-ready signal in Loki.log: "BP_MainMenuHUD_C ... BeginPlay".)

CONCRETE DATA staged for the population build:
  - MissionProgress struct layout (usmap + live; size 0x60): ID(FString)@0x00, AssetId(FPrimaryAssetId)
    @0x10, PoolId(FPrimaryAssetId)@0x20, Complete(bool)@0x30, Failed@0x31, ObjectiveProgress(TArray)
    @0x38, MillisUntilExpiry(int64)@0x48, Expiry(FDateTime)@0x50, GrantedAt@0x58.
    FPrimaryAssetId = {FPrimaryAssetType{FName Type}(8), FName Name(8)} = 16 bytes.
  - FName ids (this exe): MissionPool=0x16F06, DA_MissionPoolDailyEasy=0x29EC0A,
    DA_Mission_ArmoryDaily_PlayAGame=0x24028C, DA_Mission_ArmoryDaily_GetKnocks=0x19D57F.
    (Mission type FName for AssetId — resolve a bare "Mission" in the shim.)
  - MissionsModel maps: Missions(FString->UMissionModel*)@+0x30, Pools@+0x80, CompletionCounts@+0xD0.

POPULATION PLAN (Phase 2b, empirical — CAUTION each is a live write, crash-prone):
  Uncertainty: CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress = likely END-OF-GAME (FinalMissionProgress), maybe
  NOT the menu list. Menu Missions map is fed by OnPSMissionsUpdated / CreateMissionsModel from a
  LokiPlayerState_Missions. So EXPERIMENT (log-only first, via the working primitive):
    (1) call CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress(1x MissionProgress) then GetMissions().Num — did it
        insert? inspect the returned UMissionModel. If Num>0, factory inserts -> just broadcast.
    (2) if not, the map insert must be done manually (FString-keyed FScriptMap add w/ FCrc strihash)
        OR construct a LokiPlayerState_Missions, fill its Missions array, and call CreateMissionsModel
        (which likely populates `this` and returns it) — cleanest if it works.
    (3) broadcast MissionsModel.OnUpdated (or the 3 delegates at +0x?? — resolve) so categories rebuild;
        open the Missions modal, screenshot the Dailies tab (computer-use) to confirm tiles.
CLIENT STATE after this session: fresh PID 27412 running catalog_store_fix (roster/store OK) + NO pi8
  (so pick->center refresh is OFF this launch) + the idle read-only probes. Ready for the population shim.

*** PHASE 2b EXPERIMENT RESULT — factory-population DOES NOT WORK (2026-07-06, live, NO crash) ***
tools/sigbypass-mod/missions_populate2.cpp: built one MissionProgress (ID="ArmoryDaily_PlayAGame",
AssetId=Mission:ArmoryDaily_PlayAGame, PoolId=MissionPool:*, valid FDateTimes), called the factory via
the verified ProcessEvent primitive, checked GetMissions().Num before/after. Marker
docs/missions-populate2-marker.txt:
    factory returned model=0x0 (NULL)
    GetMissions().Num before=0 after=0  => factory does NOT insert into the map
The factory ran cleanly (no crash) but REJECTED the synthetic input and returned null. Disasm of its
native impl (Func@+0xE0, rva 0x54A58B0) shows the standard exec-thunk FFrame stepping; the
MissionProgress param is flagged **out** (CPF_OutParm), i.e. CreateMissionModelFromFinalProgress most
likely computes the player's REAL final progress internally and IGNORES the passed array — returning
null because there is NO real mission/player state at the menu.

CONCLUSION — missions is HARDER than roster/store; the model-poke shortcut does NOT translate:
  * roster/store were fixed by forcing a client GATE flag over data the client already had (heroes in
    the CatalogManager; cosmetics owned via inventory). MISSIONS have NO such latent data — the
    UMissionsModel maps are empty AND the game's own factory won't synthesize entries from fake input.
  * Manual UMissionModel construction + FString-map insert would still fail to RENDER: the container
    reads MissionModel.MissionAsset (a LokiDataAsset_Mission) for Hide/Hero/LobbyWidgetClass, and
    mission DAs are NOT loaded/registered as primary assets (the shared LokiAssetManager gate — the
    ORIGINAL documented missions blocker). So a populated model with null MissionAsset won't tile.
  => The missions page genuinely needs REAL mission data: (a) mission DA assets resolvable (AssetManager
     registration of the "Mission" primary asset type — the hard blocker the manifest can't carry), and
     (b) a real per-pool granted-mission set (server/replication: LokiPlayerState_Missions ->
     OnPSMissionsUpdated -> CreateMissionsModel). This re-converges on the docs/dedicated-server-stub.md
     route (Path C) PLUS asset registration — NOT a quick native poke.

WHAT WAS GAINED (durable): the game-thread native-call primitive (ProcessEvent from a ProcessInternal
  hook works for native UFunctions) is a REUSABLE capability for any future "call a native method on the
  game thread" need. The full missions API + data path is mapped. The negative result narrows the route.

NEXT OPTIONS (for a future session, pick one):
  1. ASSET-FIRST: make the "Mission" primary asset type registerable so mission DAs resolve — then the
     factory/model path may work. Needs deeper LokiAssetManager RE (register a new primary asset type at
     runtime via the native-call primitive, e.g. drive ScanPathsForPrimaryAssets/AddDynamicAsset with a
     real MissionPool path). NOTE: prior scan-shim attempts crashed in __report_gsfailure (CLAUDE.md) —
     but the game-thread ProcessEvent primitive is a NEW, safer calling avenue not tried before.
  2. PLAYERSTATE/DS route: the dedicated-server-stub plan (replicate LokiPlayerState_Missions). Largest.
  3. Accept missions as blocked-for-now and move to the next menu surface; revisit with the DS work.

*** CORRECTION (2026-07-06, later) — the Phase-2a "primitive UNLOCKED" claim was a FALSE POSITIVE ***
Pursuing the untried avenue (call LokiAssetManager natives to test/force mission asset resolution)
revealed that ProcessEvent-called-from-the-ProcessInternal-hook is a UNIFORM NO-OP — exactly pi8's
original finding, which I wrongly thought was BP-only.
  - LokiAssetManager exposes NO registration UFunction (Scan/AddDynamic are native-only, not
    reflected) — only PrimaryAssetIDFromString, GetLokiDataAsset, AsyncLoadPrimaryAssets, path getters.
  - missions_assettest2.cpp chained PrimaryAssetIDFromString("Hero:Alchemist") -> GetLokiDataAsset for
    a GUARANTEED-resolvable hero CONTROL + the mission. RESULT: BOTH returned null AND the parsed ids
    were {0,0}. PrimaryAssetIDFromString is NATIVE (Script.Num=0) and its param offsets are verified
    (AssetIDString@0, ReturnValue@16 — matched my buffer exactly), so a WORKING call on "Hero:Alchemist"
    would return a non-zero id. It returned {0,0} => the call DID NOT EXECUTE => ProcessEvent-from-hook
    no-ops for NATIVE funcs too.
  - Therefore missions_call_probe's GetMissions "-> Num=0, no crash" was NOT proof the call ran: Num=0
    is what BOTH a real empty-map read AND a no-op leave behind. The "primitive" never worked.
  CONSEQUENCE: there is NO available safe primitive to call NATIVE UFunctions with params on the game
  thread. pi8's ProcessInternal+FFrame works ONLY for BP funcs (it interprets Script bytecode; native
  funcs have Script.Num=0 => nothing runs). So the entire client-side missions-population direction
  (call the factory / readers / AssetManager natives) is NOT reachable without a DIRECT native-call-by-
  address primitive (rcx=this,... hand-rolled convention) — the crash-prone path prior sessions hit
  __report_gsfailure on, and NOT attempted here.

FINAL, HONEST STATUS OF THE MISSIONS PAGE (session 52):
  Missions is blocked at TWO independent layers, neither crackable with the current safe toolset:
   (1) DATA: the UMissionsModel maps are empty and the game's own factory won't synthesize entries from
       fake input (it derives from real player/final progress that doesn't exist at menu).
   (2) ASSETS: mission DAs are not registered/resolvable as primary assets (the original manifest-can't-
       carry-missions blocker); registration is native-only + unreachable via reflected UFunctions.
   (3) PRIMITIVE: no way to call the needed native funcs on the game thread (ProcessEvent-from-hook no-ops;
       ProcessInternal+FFrame is BP-only).
  => Unlike roster/store (force a gate over latent data), missions has NO client-side shortcut. The real
     path remains docs/dedicated-server-stub.md (replicate LokiPlayerState_Missions from a stub server) —
     that delivers BOTH real mission data AND, via the engine's own load, resolvable assets.
  DURABLE VALUE from this session regardless: the full missions BP data path + API is decompiled and
  mapped; the 346-mission/16-pool catalog is dumped; and the negative results precisely bound the route
  (client-side native-call shortcuts are OUT; DS/replication is the way).
Step A2 — POPULATE: build MissionModel/MissionPoolModel UObjects (NewObject via a BP/native
  factory on the game thread through the pi8 primitive, OR construct + fill fields by RPM),
  insert into MissionsModel.Missions/Pools TMaps keyed by pool PrimaryAssetId, using the
  recovered catalog (missions_catalog.json) for text/XP/icons. Seed a minimal smoke-test
  first: 1 pool (DA_MissionPoolDailyEasy) + its ~2 daily missions.
Step A3 — BROADCAST: fire MissionsModel.OnUpdated via pi8 InvokeBP so the subscribed
  category widgets rebuild their containers (do NOT just poke — S45 "dead delegate" gotcha).
  Verify: the Dailies tab renders the seeded mission tile(s) (computer-use screenshot).
Step A4 — SCALE: once the smoke test renders, fill all 6 categories' pools from the catalog,
  handle the per-hunter Hero filter (container hides Hero-tagged missions unless
  GetSelf().HeroAssetID matches), and make it durable (either re-broadcast on modal-open via
  a hook, or a periodic mirror like shim_watch).
Backend: persist missions_catalog.json → an index_catalog.go-style backend index so the data
  layer is ready; the model-fill values come from there even though the SHIM (not HTTP) is
  what delivers them to the client.
